contentEn.description:
free wifi

 Lovely 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom duplex apartment on the 5th floor of Block A in the beachfront Skol Building, in the heart of Marbella. This bright east-facing apartment enjoys morning sun, and has wonderful views to the sea and the Puerto Deportivo, the Parque de la Constitución, and the mountains guarding Marbella’s back. The popular Skol Building lies 50m from the famous Puerto Deportivo, and is surrounded by fine-dining restaurants, bars, and shops.

 Accommodation comprises: lift access; on the bottom floor, large living/dining room with full height windows allowing maximum light; doors to the lovely terrace; compact fitted kitchen with ho, microwave, washing machine, etc.; on the top floor, master bedroom with amazing views; second interior bedroom with twin beds; and separate bathroom with shower over bath.

 🌐 The apartment has its own Wi-Fi, ideal for working remotely.

 ❄ Private A/C in the bedrooms and the living room.

 🏊‍ Among the Skol’s facilities are its three unheated outdoors community pools, open all year round. Sunbeds have a cost of €3 per day, and are occupied on a first-come-first-served basis.

 🔑 Main reception open 24/7 to accommodate late arrivals.

 ☕ Cafeteria open seasonally, with direct access to the promenade from the community gardens.

 🛌 Bed linen and a set of towels (including beach/pool towel) per guest included in the rental price.

 Come and enjoy your holiday with the leader in vacation rentals in Marbella!

 🚗 If you want a parking space, once your reservation is confirmed, you will receive information about the parking closest to the Skol Building, which you may reserve online through an external company (price and availability on their website)
